title: News
description: Comprehensive coverage of Mysuru's most important developments — civic updates, government decisions, community initiatives, business announcements, education reforms, cultural milestones, and the stories that shape daily life in the city.

title: Journey Junction with Sumithra
tagline: Every Success Has a Journey Worth Discovering.
description: An inspiring interview-format program that uncovers the real stories behind extraordinary achievers. From entrepreneurs and educators to artists, athletes, and social changemakers — Journey Junction celebrates persistence, passion, and purpose.

title: Daiva Darshana
tagline: A Journey Through Faith, History and Heritage.
description: A spiritual travelogue exploring the sacred temples, ancient shrines, divine stories and religious heritage of Karnataka and beyond. Daiva Darshana connects communities to their spiritual roots through respectful and enriching storytelling.

title: Business Spotlight
tagline: Your Business. Your Story. Your Spotlight.
description: A dedicated platform celebrating the entrepreneurs, startups, small businesses and established brands making a mark from Mysuru. Business Spotlight shares the vision, challenges and strategies behind Mysore's growing business ecosystem.

title: Campus Crew
tagline: Discover the Campus Beyond the Classroom.
description: A vibrant campus-focused program that captures student life, college events, academic achievements, youth culture, sports, arts and everything happening inside Mysuru's colleges and universities. Campus Crew gives students a voice and a platform.

title: Roots & Reality
tagline: Real People. Real Experience. Real Conversations.
description: An authentic documentary-style conversational program that explores the lives, experiences, challenges and aspirations of real people from Mysuru — farmers, craftspeople, healthcare workers, teachers, community leaders and everyday heroes.

title: The Lost Recipes
tagline: Bringing Forgotten Flavours Back to Life.
description: The Lost Recipes is a nostalgic culinary journey dedicated to rediscovering traditional dishes once lovingly prepared by our grandmothers and passed down through generations. From forgotten ingredients and age-old cooking methods to family traditions and regional flavours, each episode brings back recipes, memories, and stories that deserve to be preserved.
